$comment: Web-only values for the QA web apps (issue 2293), merged over qa.json by tools/build-web-qa.mjs. Kept apart from qa.json because the native QA builds must not carry a reCAPTCHA site key: they get App Check tokens from App Attest and Play Integrity, and capacitor://localhost is no reCAPTCHA domain. The site key is the bite-tribe-qa reCAPTCHA Enterprise key 'Bite Tribe QA Web', allowed on the three QA hosting sites. Public config only.
